description: Trigger evaluation set for the editorial skill: requests that SHOULD activate it (writing, editing, formatting prose, even when the word editorial is not said) and near-miss negatives that should NOT. Used by the develop trigger smoke test and by `develop optimize`.
should_trigger: draft a reply declining this partnership, keep it warm
write a thank-you email to my landlord
clean up these notes into a doc
proofread this before I send it
turn this rough outline into an essay
reword this message so it sounds less harsh
write the body of this Library article
should_not_trigger: research the current state of solid-state batteries
refactor this function to use async await
build me a skill that drafts invoices
diagram the OAuth login flow for me
what is the capital of Australia
look into whether GLP-1 drugs reduce cardiovascular risk
fix the bug in my Python script
notes: Editorial is structurally scoped: it fires on producing or improving prose a person will read (emails, messages, docs, notes, article bodies), even when the word editorial is absent. It does NOT fire on investigating facts (research), building skills (develop), a chat-only visual (visualize), arithmetic or established-fact lookups, code tasks, or vault-script maintenance. 'Diagram this for me' as a chat answer is visualize; a diagram inside a file under edit would be editorial. Auto-fire also excludes System, agent-roster, log, template, index, and script files and any write a vault script makes, even though those are technically text.
